 after calling for all the records pertaining to the passing of the  order Na.Ka.No. 2/23515/2016 dated 07.12.2018 on the file of the  1st respondent and quash the same and consequently direct the 1st  respondents to pay the compensation as per the provision of Act  30 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land  Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and National Highways Act, 1956.
For Petitioner : No appearance
For R1,R2 & R5 : Mr.A.Kannan
Additional Government Pleader
For R3 : Mr.Su.Srinivasan  Panel Counsel  For R4 : Mr.R.Rajaraman
CGSC  ORDER
It is seen that on 07.09.2020, when the matter was taken up there was no representation for the petitioner.
On 29.11.2024 also, there was no representation for the petitioner and therefore the Registry was directed to list the matter under the caption ''For Dismissal''.
Even today, there is no representation for the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis petitioner.
It appears that the petitiner is not interested in prosecuting the case.
Hence, this Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
No costs.
